title: Austin Officials Bond Approval Delayed
summary:
• **Bond Review Postponed**: The council deferred action on the newly elected City Engineer and street commissioners' official bonds until the next regular meeting, citing the need for further examination.

• **Special Committee Formed**: Three aldermen (Schneider, Shumate, and Shurruff) were appointed to review and evaluate all bonds from officers elected on April 1st, 1901, with a report due at the next council meeting.

• **Full Council Present**: All seven aldermen attended the special evening session called by Mayor Geo. A. Walton, indicating the importance of the officer qualification process.

Called meeting of the City Council
Austin Texas April 08, 1901
Hon Geo. A. Walton mayor presiding
Roll Called
Present Alderman Gillis Law Nitschke Schneider Shelley Shumate and Shurruff
Absent none
The following Call of the Council was read
Austin Texas April 8th 1901.
To the members of the City Council of the City of Austin: A special meeting of the City
Council of the City of Austin is hereby Called to convene at the Council Chamber at the
City Hall in Austin Texas at 5 o'clock P.M. this date for the purpose of Approving the
official bond of the City Engineer and officer street Commissioners elect and elect other
subordinate officers Geo. A. Walton
Mayor
J.M. Shurruff
Theodon Law
J.P. Schneider
R.A. Gillis
Austin Texas April 8th 1901.
I hereby certify that I have this day served the within Call for a special meeting of the
City Council by reading same to the following named Aldermen towit: R.A. Gillis Theordon
Law J.B. Nitschke J.P. Schneider T.A. Shelley J.M. Shumate and Joseph Shurruff
A.S. Thorn City Marshal
By A.H. Erwin Deputy
Bonds of all Aldermen Shumate moved to defer action on the bond of newly elected City
Engineer and other street Commissioners elect and until the next regular meeting of the
Council which motion prevailed Alderman Schneider moved that the bond of City Engineer and
street Commissioner elect Sneed, together with the bonds of all other officers elected at
the election held on April 1st 1901, who were ready to qualify, be referred to a Special
Committee of three for examination, and that they report on same at the next regular
Meeting of the Council, which motion prevailed.
The Mayor appointed Aldermen Schneider Shumate and
Shurruff as such Committee.
On motion of Alderman Nitschke the Council adjourned. Geo. O. Johnson
City Clerk.
